# Startup readback: AI-22

Contract version: 1

## Objective and acceptance outcomes

Replace the authenticated app's flat navigation with intent-led grouped navigation, a compact/expanded desktop rail, and a keyboard command palette while preserving all 19 existing destinations and the authenticated canvas. Acceptance: (1) groups make everyday work, manager destinations, operational attention, and administration scannable at desktop and usable at narrow widths; (2) Ctrl/Cmd+K opens a provider-backed palette whose route and common-command results support keyboard selection, focus containment and restoration; (3) current routes, direct URLs, browser back/forward, theme/session controls, and the existing AAL2 boundary continue to work.

## Dependencies and relevant contracts

AI-13 supplies the AAL2 guard and authenticated-route contract; AI-21 supplies tokens and primitives. The Agent Spec owns manager identity and keeps Planner distinct from specialist roles. The Build Spec requires authentication before authenticated UI and a reachable global route inventory. The Frontend Constitution requires intent groups, command palette, stable compact/expanded navigation, focus visibility, responsive behavior, reduced-motion support, and route preservation. No open sibling PR was found at startup; origin/main is 2c7884ff00f177e2974e01a2c5b05e97178c038b.

## Implementation and boundaries

The current surface is apps/web/app/(app)/layout.tsx plus global CSS; the 19 explicit hrefs are the route compatibility source. Keep AppLayout server-rendered and retain requireAal2(); put only interactive rail/palette state in client components. Build an explicit typed route catalog and a command-provider interface so later conversations/runs/attention sources can add results without changing palette mechanics. Do not link to routes that do not yet exist or invent counters without an authoritative source. No schema, permission, auth, or integration changes are in scope.

## Local tests and commands

Use the web component/route Vitest suite for nav catalog coverage, compact-state persistence, palette filtering/selection/keyboard/focus, and route preservation; add a targeted Chromium journey for direct URL, grouped navigation, palette, and history. Run the smallest affected tests while iterating, then corepack pnpm verify:changed before PR. QA doctor --fix already passed in this isolated worktree after the initial missing-tsx install recovery.

## Hosted proof and readiness

The declared hosted-only proof is one staging journey with a real authenticated AAL2 session: navigate through a group, load a direct URL, open Ctrl/Cmd+K, use browser back/forward, and verify keyboard focus remains usable; capture a small desktop screenshot set. This cannot be established locally because staging identity and deployment are real hosted boundaries. Wait until the headed browser is ready, then ask the operator to complete MFA; no credential values or screenshots containing personal data belong in repository evidence.

## Delegation and blockers

Matthew owns AI-22 implementation through merge in its isolated worktree; there are no subagents on this ticket. AI-39, AI-41, and AI-45 own separate worktrees and their changes are independent so far. Serialize staging/candidate acceptance and coordinate if a migration or shared integration rule is later needed. No human gate is active now; user input is required only when a headed staging browser reaches the login/MFA screen.
